searchText: Is it also safe to update to Geth 1.10.18 when running mainnet? (Just to be sure) yes What channel should I go to for devp2p questions? Are any/all of the following transactions valid in a block? A. Account Balance: 0.00021 ETH; Base Fee: 10e9; Max Fee: 10e9; Priority Fee: 1e9; Gas Limit: 21,000; Gas Used: 21,000 B. Account Balance: 0.00021 ETH; Base Fee: 10e9; Max Fee: 11e9; Priority Fee: 1e9; Gas Limit: 21,000; Gas Used: 21,000 C. Account Balance: 0.00021 ETH; Base Fee: 10e9; Max Fee: 10e9; Priority Fee: 1e9; Gas Limit: 50,000; Gas Used: 21,000 D. Account Balance: 0.00021 ETH; Base Fee: 10e9; Gas Price: 11e9; Gas Limit: 21,000; Gas Used: 21,000 E. Account Balance: 0.00021 ETH; Base Fee: 10e9; Gas Price: 11e9; Gas Limit: 50,000; Gas Used: 21,000 In all of them, `naive_gas_price * gas_limit > account balance`. They are all variations on that theme. However, all of them have enough balance to cover exactly `base_fee * gas_used`. Afaict based on EIP-1559, `effective_gas_price * gas_limit` is the minimum required [0]. I'm not sure I follow e.g. your "E" example, that one doesn't satisfy your `naive_gas_price * gas_limit > account balance` right? Also, the balance check is `>= 0` (not `> 0`). [0] There was an issue with this at some point with EIP-1559, whether the sender's balance had already had the transferred amount deduced or not. Not relevant for your examples as there is no transfer of ETH involved, but nonetheless related: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3681 / https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/retrospectives/london.md
